name: Dynamic Input Buffer
description: Adjustable keyboard input buffering system with configurable delay and diagnostic overlays.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer Delay (Frames)
buffer-frames.description: Number of physics frames (240Hz reference) to delay keyboard inputs. 0 = Unbuffered/Vanilla.

show-diagnostics.name: Show Input Diagnostics
show-diagnostics.description: Display current frame buffer depth and pending queue size on screen during gameplay.
